title: Boundary contract
prompt: Implement `static bool IsAdult(int age)` — true for 18 and above (throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` for negative ages) — and `static string Grade(int score)` mapping 90+ → "A", 80–89 → "B", 70–79 → "C", 60–69 → "D", below 60 → "F" (each boundary inclusive at the bottom of its band; score outside 0–100 → `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`).

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Every band edge is asserted — both sides of each boundary.

tests.name: rejects
tests.hint: Rejects are explicit; the legal extremes still classify.
